capabilities: Manage characters, locations, events, items, and other story entities as linked notes
Build timelines and Gantt-style dependency views with tracks, eras, and conflict detection
Run D&D campaign sessions with party tracking, shared inventory, and scene graphs
Compile manuscripts into reader, editor, HTML, and plain-text outputs via reusable workflows
Place entities on image-based maps or OpenStreetMap tiles with portal navigation
extras: The timeline redesign is explicitly marked as beta. Ships with English and Chinese translations, and custom compile steps can execute user-written JavaScript.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for story entities, chronology views, live TTRPG session tracking, or reusable manuscript compile workflows across a vault.

relations.evidence: Storyteller Suite includes a Leaflet-based map system that works with both vault images and real-world tiles.
OpenStreetMap tile mode for real-world settings

summary: Story-planning suite that manages characters, locations, events, timelines, maps, D&D campaign sessions, and manuscript compilation as linked notes.
